intro.name: Aditya Raj
intro.title: AI / Python Developer & Data Analyst
intro.about: I build AI-assisted workflows, Python applications, and dashboards that turn operational data into useful decisions. My work spans recruitment automation, voice agents, business intelligence, and data processing. I am focused on AI / Python Developer and Data Analyst opportunities, with Python backend development as a supporting track.

projects.name: Slicer Analytics Dashboard
projects.shortDescription: Operational dashboards for work allocation, submissions, rework, and settlements.
projects.description: Built an analytics dashboard around Slicer operations, covering completed work, assignments, pending work, rework batches, and settlement periods. Worked on MongoDB-backed reporting, date filtering, and admin tools for user mappings and settlement management.
highlights: Built reporting for assignments, submissions, pending work, and rework.
Worked on settlement-period filters and user-ID mappings.
Implemented batch rework rules and investigated reporting consistency.
Created individual and periodic Excel reports with openpyxl.
Worked on batch aggregation checks to reconcile fresh and rework durations.

caseStudy.challenge: Keep operational reporting consistent across assignments, rework, and settlement periods.
caseStudy.contribution: Dashboard components, reporting workflows, date/user filters, and batch-level reconciliation.

steps.title: Collect
steps.description: Bring together assignment and submission records from the operational workflow.

steps.title: Reconcile
steps.description: Separate fresh work and rework, then check that durations reconcile with totals.

steps.title: Explore
steps.description: Use user and settlement-period filters for the reporting question at hand.

steps.title: Report
steps.description: Produce individual and periodic Excel workbooks with openpyxl.

caseStudy.boundary: The batch-rule demo below uses fictional clips. It illustrates the confirmed rule, not live company data.

projects.name: Video Segmentation Overlay
projects.shortDescription: Slicer script with custom playback, segmentation controls and native clip workflow integration.
projects.description: Built the Slicer script at SSHD Technologies, including a custom video overlay with independent playback and segmentation controls synchronised with the native clip workflow. The work includes split boundaries, deletion priority, selected-segment looping, and native submission integration.
highlights: Worked on synchronising overlay segments and native clips.
Defined splitting, selection-aware deletion, and segment-loop behaviour.

caseStudy.challenge: Make clip boundaries and editing actions easier to control over a native video workflow.
caseStudy.contribution: Custom overlay controls and segment operations synchronised with native clips.

steps.title: Locate
steps.description: Identify the segment containing the playhead.

steps.title: Split
steps.description: Replace that segment with its left and right pieces at the playhead.

steps.title: Control
steps.description: Give the selected segment priority for deletion and segment-loop actions.

steps.title: Relay
steps.description: Synchronise segment operations with the native clip/submission workflow.

caseStudy.boundary: The interactive timeline is a standalone boundary demo. It does not edit a real video or call the native Slicer platform.
